personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile typography with 4 Tactile / Playful layout & gamification
personality_one_liner: A bold, high-contrast, gamified fitness tracker that combines chunky tactile cards with aggressive typography for ultimate accountability.

spacing.rule: Use generous tactile spacing for cards (md/lg gaps) but tight typographic lockups inside headers. No cramped padding on active targets.

do's: Use subtle glass effect for the bottom tab bar
Use frosted glass on the 'Prove Your Workout' sticky CTA container
dont's: Do not use glass for normal white list cards or stats cards
Do not use glass on form inputs

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: High-impact splash and value prop introducing GymProof.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a heavy gradient scrim (top to bottom). Bold display typography in bottom 40%, pinned 'Get Started' CTA. Seamlessly transitions to Clerk OTP login sheet.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Collect user baseline stats and target goals (Name, Age, Height, Gender, Goal, Weekly Target, City).
screens.layout: Step-by-step wizard. 1 question per screen. Chunky pill selections, large touch targets, oversized sliders for numbers, smooth sticky CTA anchored at the bottom with keyboard avoidance.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard for daily accountability featuring the Duolingo-style streak widget and workout proof entry.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks for widget and feed
states.empty: Illustration of flame with zero streak

screens.layout: Light grey background (`surface`). Top section: Duolingo-style Streak Widget (white card, bold numeric streak, prominent flame icon/mascot logic, dynamic states: completed/pending/week completed). Below: Today's status/plan. Bottom: Sticky, large 'Prove Your Workout' CTA overriding scroll context.

screens.name: Camera Proof
screens.purpose: In-app camera to take a photo of gym equipment/grip for AI verification.
screens.layout: Full-screen camera viewfinder (`expo-camera`). Outline guide for hand/equipment. Snap button at bottom center. Followed by a 'Processing/Verifying' loading overlay, then a celebratory 'Day Complete!' modal.

screens.name: Board (Leaderboard)
screens.purpose: City XP Leaderboard gamifying the experience against local peers.

states.empty: No users found in your city illustration

screens.layout: Bold uppercase header. Top 3 users get a podium-style layout (larger avatars, crown accents). Below: Stacked white cards on light grey background, listing Rank, Avatar, Name, XP.

screens.name: Stats
screens.purpose: Detailed breakdown of weekly targets, streaks, and achievements.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for charts and weekday row
states.empty: No stats to show yet, complete a workout!

screens.layout: Top: Bold uppercase 'STATISTICS' header with a yellow hexagon (`brandSecondary`) behind the letter 'S'. Section titles have yellow-orange (`brandPrimary`) underline highlights. Weekday row (Mon-Sun) displaying flame icons for completed days. Segmented control pills for Weekly/Monthly/All-Time toggle. White rounded cards showcasing stats.

screens.name: Me
screens.purpose: User profile, settings, and achievement gallery.
screens.layout: Profile header (avatar, username, total XP). Milestone gallery grid (4/8/12/26 weeks). Settings list using chunky white cards and simple chevrons.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT COMPLIANCE: Adhere strictly to the requested aesthetic: light grey backgrounds, white rounded cards, bold black uppercase typography, and energetic yellow-orange accents.
NAVIGATION: Create a 4-tab bottom bar (Home, Board, Stats, Me). The active tab MUST use a dark/black icon color (`onSurface`), while inactive tabs use grey (`muted`).

HEADER SPECIFICS: For the 'Stats' tab, construct the 'STATISTICS' header exactly as requested: bold, uppercase, with an absolute-positioned yellow hexagon SVG (`brandSecondary`) sitting behind the first letter. Use an underline highlight (`brandPrimary`) for section titles.

WIDGETS: On the Home screen, build a chunky, Duolingo-style streak widget with 3 clear visual states: 'completed' (flame on, celebratory), 'pending' (greyed out or warning color), and 'week completed' (special milestone state).

LAYOUT: Apply 'Brutalist typography' rules to headers (Space Grotesk, large, uppercase) but pair them with 'Tactile / Playful' component shapes (pill segments, fully rounded white cards, generous padding).
INTERACTION: The 'Prove Your Workout' CTA must be unmissable. Keep it pinned to the bottom of the Home screen (or prominently centered) with a solid or frosted glass container behind it.
CAMERA: Ensure the 'Prove Workout' action opens the in-app camera natively via expo-camera, blocking gallery uploads to enforce real-time accountability.
